main_body: stone tower building with green conical roof
top_band: green tiled conical roof slope from row 4 to row 39
evidence: The structure has a tall pitched green roof visible from above (rows 4-39, 36 rows) with a darker eave overhang/shadow at rows 40-41, sitting over a grey stone front wall (rows 42-94, 53 rows) with an inset window and recessed doorway.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings, the stone blocks are large uniform rectangular fills (8x3 px of flat grey) with no per-stone shading or speckle, the roof tiles are simple flat 2-row checker bands rather than scalloped detailed tiles with highlights, and the door planks are flat vertical strips.
